reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: Shoppers grab a familiar bag off the snack aisle by taste and craving, rebuying whatever the household eats and only worrying that the chips are stale, bland, or too flimsy for dipping.

scenarios.label: Weekly family stockup
scenarios.description: The primary grocery trip where the household grabs their usual tortilla chips for the week.

scenarios.label: Party hosting cart
scenarios.description: Buying multiple bags and flavors for a gathering where guests and quantity matter.

scenarios.label: Taco night fixings
scenarios.description: Picking chips alongside salsa and toppings for a planned taco or nacho dinner.

scenarios.label: Budget big bag
scenarios.description: Choosing a value or store-brand large bag to stretch snacks affordably.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Weekly family stockup|generic] kids keep raiding the pantry after school and want something crunchy and salty. everything I grab either gets smashed in backpacks or goes stale fast. what should I get that holds up, not too messy, shareable?

[problem_recognition|Party hosting cart|generic] hosting this weekend. great spread planned but nothing to scoop with. stuff I pick up either crumbles or tastes stale. want something super crunchy and sturdy that actually tastes good.
[problem_recognition|Taco night fixings|generic] taco night on Tuesday. want a crispy salty side people can nibble before and during. kid friendly, not spicy, won't make a mess. what fits that job?

[problem_recognition|Budget big bag|generic] need a big bag of something crunchy for movie nights that won't vanish in two handfuls. budget about 5 bucks. not greasy, actually tastes like corn. ideas?
[category_education|-|generic] for a party setup, what exactly are tortilla chips? how are they made, what are they for, and why do some work better for scooping than others?
[discovery|Weekly family stockup|generic] best tortilla chips for kids' lunchboxes and after-school grazing? need ones that don't shatter to dust and aren't spicy.
[discovery|Party hosting cart|generic] best tortilla chips for a party with queso and guac? want real corn flavor, thick enough for scooping, not oily, and a couple different textures if possible.
[discovery|Taco night fixings|generic] best tortilla chips to serve with tacos and mild salsa for family dinner? crunchy, not too salty.
[discovery|Budget big bag|generic] what are the best budget big-bag tortilla chips that actually taste fresh and stay crisp for a couple days after opening?
[shortlist|Weekly family stockup|generic] can you give me 3 or 4 tortilla chip options that are kid-friendly and hold up in lunchboxes?
[shortlist|Party hosting cart|generic] i'm hosting 15 people with queso and guac. name a few tortilla chip picks with bold corn flavor and strong scoopability, ideally different textures to compare.
[shortlist|Taco night fixings|generic] shortlist a few tortilla chip options that go well with tacos and mild salsa, not too salty.
[shortlist|Budget big bag|generic] i just need a cheap big bag. point me to a few tortilla chip options that are good value but still taste like real corn.
[criteria|Weekly family stockup|generic] weekly grocery stockup for the family. for tortilla chips, what should I actually pay attention to so they taste good all week and don't go stale by Friday?

[criteria|Party hosting cart|generic] hosting a game night with salsa, guac, and queso. how do I pick tortilla chips that taste great solo but also scoop well? what really matters - thickness, salt level, corn flavor?
[criteria|Taco night fixings|generic] doing taco night. what should I look for in chips for sheet-pan nachos vs just chips on the side? want good corn flavor and crunch, not soggy or too salty.
[criteria|Budget big bag|generic] need a big bag on a budget that isn't bland or half air. what clues on the shelf or bag help me pick a decent value tortilla chip?

[use_case|Weekly family stockup|generic] I'm packing two school lunches a day. want tortilla chips we can portion out that won't crush in baggies and still taste fresh by midweek. which style should I grab and how do I store them?

[use_case|Party hosting cart|generic] building a party spread for about 15: pico, chunky guac, warm queso. which chip shapes pair best with each so they don't break, and roughly how many ounces should I buy?

[use_case|Taco night fixings|generic] making sheet-pan nachos plus chips on the side. which tortilla chips hold up in the oven under beans/cheese, and should I pre-toast the chips to keep them crunchy?

[use_case|Budget big bag|generic] college movie night, tight budget. need one large bag of tortilla chips that works with jar salsa and doesn't taste like cardboard. which types usually hit best value?
[social_validation|-|generic] what do people gush about with their go-to tortilla chips - crunch, seasoning dust, scoopability, that kind of thing? why do fans stick to one bag over others?

[comparison|Party hosting cart|Tostitos] debating Doritos or Tostitos for a game-night dip bar. which actually plays nicer with salsa, guac, and queso, and where does each fall short (breakage, saltiness, flavor clashing)?

[comparison|Party hosting cart|Mission] for loaded nachos and dips, how do Doritos compare to Mission? thinking sturdiness in the oven, corn flavor, oiliness, and whether the seasoning fights the toppings.

[comparison|Party hosting cart|Santitas] big party question: Doritos vs Santitas. which is the safer crowd pleaser, and which pairs better with fresh pico and warm queso without overpowering everything?
[comparison|Party hosting cart|Late July] Doritos vs Late July for a more foodie-leaning spread - craft salsa, crema, roasted corn. if I still want a wow factor, which is the smarter pick and why?
[premium_worth|-|generic] stocking up for the week and doing taco night too. are the pricier tortilla chips really better for dips and nachos, or are the big cheap store bags fine?
[objections|Weekly family stockup|generic] Do Doritos actually hold up to chunky salsa for a whole week of snacking, or do they snap and leave orange dust everywhere?

[objections|Party hosting cart|generic] Hosting 20 with big bowls of guac and queso. Are Doritos a bad call because the seasoning clashes and the chips break in the bowl, or will they perform for a crowd?
[objections|Taco night fixings|generic] Taco night question: do Doritos make solid nachos, or does the seasoning overpower everything and the chips go soggy under cheese and beans?
[objections|Budget big bag|generic] On a tight budget: if I grab the biggest bag of Doritos, am I just paying for a lot of broken pieces and dust at the bottom?

[pricing|Weekly family stockup|generic] For weekly stockup, is the Doritos family size actually better value than buying two regular bags once you factor price per ounce and how fresh it stays through Friday?

[pricing|Party hosting cart|generic] Party cart math: better value to do one party-size Doritos as the bold option, or spend the same on plain tortilla chips plus a smaller flavored bag so more people dip them? Thinking cost per ounce vs satisfaction.
[pricing|Taco night fixings|generic] For taco-night nachos, is paying extra for seasoned tortilla chips worth it, or are plain chips the better value once toppings cover the flavor?
[pricing|Budget big bag|generic] Need a budget big bag of tortilla chips that won't taste stale or bland. What's the best price per ounce option that still holds up to salsa?
[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've bought Doritos for years, but lately the chips feel thinner and the bags seem lighter. Keep buying them, or switch to something sturdier?
[alternatives|-|defensive] Not feeling Doritos lately. What other tortilla chips scratch that same itch? Prefer bold flavors, good for snacking straight, not just dipping.
[alternatives|-|Tostitos] If the store's out of Tostitos, what chips should I grab instead for salsa night? Need sturdy scoopers, lightly salted.
[alternatives|-|Mission] Mission tortilla chips keep breaking on me. What brands or styles hold up better for nachos?
[alternatives|-|Santitas] I usually get Santitas because they're cheap. Any other budget tortilla chips that don't taste like cardboard?
[alternatives|-|Late July] Late July is a bit pricier at my store. Any similar organic-ish tortilla chips worth trying, maybe sea salt and lime?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] Just opened a big bag of nacho cheese tortilla chips and half are crushed and taste stale even though it's weeks before the date. Anything I can do to crisp them back up, and who do I contact to report a bad batch?

[expansion|-|generic] We keep a couple bags of the spicy nacho triangles around for movie nights. Thinking of rolling them into game day spreads too. What crowd-pleaser combos or party-size packs should I look for?

[ecosystem|-|generic] What dips and toppings pair best with super-seasoned tortilla chips so the flavors don't clash? Also, any clip or container you like that actually keeps them crunchy after opening?

[advocacy|-|generic] My brother says these flavored triangle chips are just junk food dye. How do I make the case for them, like points on taste, portioning, or better ways to eat them than straight from the bag?

[repertoire|-|generic] I always buy the classic nacho cheese ones. Should I branch into other flavors from the same line, or switch it up with plain salted for dips? What's the smarter move if I'm trying to cut back a little on sodium?
